evidence.quote: StreamPETR achieves significant performance improvements only with negligible computation cost, compared to the single-frame baseline.
On the standard nuScenes benchmark, it is the first online multiview method that achieves comparable performance (67.6% NDS & 65.3% AMOTA) with lidar-based methods.
